text:
Ellie (Marketing): ok team, trying to crystallize the 'speed -> dollars' narrative for the upcoming benchmark launch. want something punchy for the blog + webinar.
Rishi (PM): high level: show how same task costs differ by latency profile and routing. emphasize predictable unit economics. short headline first slide.
Marcos (Data): got the raw numbers from last run. can surface median p95 latencies and tokens-per-dollar for each config. will share a slice table shortly.
Sofia (Growth): audience question — do we lead with 'latency savings' or 'cost per 1k tokens'? different hooks for devs vs procurement.
Ellie (Marketing): devs -> speed story (saving dev time & UX). procurement/eng -> tokens/dollars. we'll create 2 lead hooks and A/B the landing copy.
Jae (Designer): for visuals I can do a 3-panel: left = latency distribution, middle = cost per 1k tokens bar, right = recommended routing decision tree.
Marcos (Data): uploaded sample CSV to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcXYZ (private). columns: model, quant, region, p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens, cost_usd.
Rishi (PM): perfect. can we also compute an 'effective dollars per 1k tokens at target SLO' metric? e.g. pick p95<=200ms then compute cost.
Marcos (Data): yes. quick pseudo: ```filter(p95 <= 200) group_by(model, quant) summarize(cost_per_1k = sum(cost)/sum(tokens) * 1000)```
Sofia (Growth): for webinar registration CTA we should ask: 'Are you optimizing for latency or cost?' collect that in the form to route leads.
Ellie (Marketing): routing idea: if they pick latency -> self-serve trial + 'low-latency' playbook; if cost -> schedule solutions call. good?
Sofia (Growth): yup. Growth will build form and rules in HubSpot. will map to SDR queue if enterprise/answers indicate procurement.
Jae (Designer): visual note: use step gradients on the latency heatmap to show SLO bands (fast/ok/slow). include tooltips explaining KV cache and batching impact.
Rishi (PM): also include a small 'how we measured' panel: test harness, seq len distribution, batching policy. one-liner only to avoid nitty-gritty.
Ellie (Marketing): slide flow draft: 1) headline claim, 2) methodology (one-liner), 3) three visuals (latency dist / cost per 1k / routing), 4) call-to-action + webinar date.
Marcos (Data): can produce two versions of charts: raw numbers and normalized (tokens fixed). will push images to the shared figma board.
Jae (Designer): send figma link when ready. I'll mock up 2 headline options: 'Faster = cheaper for real workloads' vs 'Make inference costs predictable'.
Ellie (Marketing): prefer neutral: 'Predictable inference economics at scale' — less clickbaity, better for enterprise leads.
Sofia (Growth): for email copy test we'll run 2 subject lines matching the two personas. I'll set up UTM parameters for each routing path.
Rishi (PM): tiny ask: add a short slide on fallbacks & routing: show how cheaper quant or region fallback keeps service online under congestion.
Marcos (Data): added a quick table comparing throughput and unit cost for 3 fallbacks. will include sample numbers in the slide notes.
ConsoleBot: Webinar scheduled by @Sofia for 2025-12-03 11:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent. :tada:
Ellie (Marketing): awesome. next steps: Marcos -> push chart PNGs by EOD tomorrow. Jae -> first mockups by noon next Wed. Sofia -> form + landing by next Fri.
Rishi (PM): I'll update the product notes and the one-line methodology. tagging @Marcos for any missing test parameters.
Marcos (Data): on it. will add a small readme in the sheet explaining the harness (seq dist, batching, KV options) so reviewers can reproduce.
Sofia (Growth): also thinking post-webinar asset: single-page 'decision map' for choosing latency vs cost configs — good inbound magnet.
Ellie (Marketing): love that. final ask: keep all public-facing claims tied to numbers (p95, tokens/1k, region). no vague 'up to' without baseline.
Rishi (PM): agreed. we'll include exact test conditions in an appendix link for folks who want the full dataset.
Jae (Designer): will prepare both social-size images + 16:9 slide assets. will flag any copy that needs tightening.
Ellie (Marketing): thanks team — i'll stitch a draft blog + slide deck after Marcos drops charts. ping here when assets are live. :sparkles:
Sofia (Growth): routing matrix to HubSpot -> SDR rules will be ready before landing goes live. will test flows in staging.
Marcos (Data): charts uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/DEF123/bench-charts (restricted). note: cost axis in USD per 1k tokens.
Ellie (Marketing): perfect. closing the loop — we'll run the two headline A/Bs for 1 week pre-webinar, then choose winner for paid ads.
Rishi (PM): tiny doc pointer: add the quantization configs used. otherwise people will ask.
Ellie (Marketing): noted. thanks all.
